independence_statement: New independent auditor with no repair authorship. Read only the exact assigned candidate, its two source manifests, identified primary sources and their permitted reading/provenance derivatives. No question bank, answer key, asked-fact map, coverage review, reader output, grades, prior source audit, repair history, peer output, module code, alternate state, aspect or runtime log was inspected. Manifest identity_proof/provenance_ledger references to peer outputs were not followed. Candidate was treated solely as the object under review. Parent coordination received only process progress and did not supply a substantive ruling. No delegation and no git mutation.
limitations: Verdict is limited to original 2017 standard core on balanced boards, normal Blight, solo and the stated introductory alternatives. Adversaries, scenarios, thematic maps, optional difficulty/scoring, expansions/promos and later-product examples were not required or imported.

Individual numeric Power/track/card payloads remain on components as expressly allowed; all assigned original-eight front/back procedures and all 31 assigned core card faces were inspected. This is a procedural source audit, not arbitrary card-combination enumeration.

Facsimiles are primary printed artwork recovered by a community asset locator. Identity was independently corroborated using official CORE/FAQ, publisher prose and dated 2017 physical left/middle-eight photograph. The low-resolution physical photos corroborate identity/layout, not every small numeral.

Raw HTML transports were hash-checked and reconciled to complete prose reading derivatives; publisher B&C prose was independently extracted and completely read. Catalog JS/module metadata were not rules authority.

The first combined four-panel output failed the tool IPC size limit; all sixteen panels were then successfully received separately with detail original. This resolved delivery issue did not limit grading.
source_hierarchy: Current official 32-page CORE plus applicable official Living FAQ; primary printed core faces for specific procedures; publisher B&C symbol legend and designer corrections for membership. Historical 2017 prose supports identity and reachability only and does not override current rules.
